title: ScVal whose union discriminant (99) names no arm in the Protocol 30 XDR definitions
caps_note: A cross-cutting encoding rule rather than a CAP: it applies to every XDR value of every protocol
why: A union discriminant must select a declared arm; 99 is past SCV_EXECUTABLE_TAG (22), the last ScValType at Protocol 30. A decoder that maps unknown arms to a default or skips them reads a value that is not there.

source.reason: ScVal discriminant 99 has no arm in the XDR definitions; core's decoder rejects undeclared union arms

notes: Probe vector 6f. The committed core transcript uses discriminant 23 ("bad value of type in SCVal"); stellar-core 30.0.0 print-xdr --filetype scval on these exact bytes (discriminant 99) gives the same error (run by hand for this entry).
